_doc: F9: the wilds around Thornfield (scripts/world/thornfield/wilds.gd and friends). Every position is an [x, z] offset in metres from the Thornfield settlement centre (WorldGen.settlements by name), so it follows the town if the layout moves. Places were picked on dry ground 60-420 m out, forested or hilly, away from the road. The outpost is NOT placed here: it sits where data/careers/soldier_career.json puts the Soldier career's post (posts.outposts[0].offset + radius); only its fort layout (local frame: x across the road, z along it) is here. The Rift's room layout is data/region1/world/thornfield_rift.json.

safety._doc: safety 0..1 = max(road, runestone cover), minus forest_penalty * forest density; 1 inside the town. danger = (base + (1 - base) * (1 - safety)) * Frontier.danger_mult(hour): road by day ~0.15, off-road by day ~1.0, off-road at deep night ~3.0.

hidden.name: Hunter's Cache
hidden.text: A hollow log lined with oilcloth. A hunter's tally is cut into the bark: wolves, wolves, wolves, and one bear. Whoever stored this planned to come back in the cold months.

hidden.name: Shrine of the Ash-Warden
hidden.text: Three stones, one fallen. The carving shows a figure with a flame in each hand standing between a village and a dark seam in the sky. Beneath it: 'The stones hold while the keeper keeps the flame. When a stone is dark, a road is lost.'
hidden.fact_text: The first wardens kept the runestones lit by hand. A dark stone means a lost road, and the old shrines mark where they stood.

hidden.name: Miner's Nook
hidden.text: A crack in the hillside, shored with two rotten props. Somebody mined here alone.

hidden.name: Fallen-Tree Glade
hidden.text: A pine came down across the gully years ago and became a bridge. On the far side the light is different, and the air smells of crushed mint.

hidden.name: Orrin's Hut
lines: "I came out here when the sky began to leak. Watch the south: the Rift breathes in and breathes out, and the wolves go where it breathes."
"The camp at the cleft is a soldier's camp now. They keep a fire, a bed and a quartermaster who counts every candle. Stay close to the fire and you can sleep."
"Keep to the road by day and it will keep you. Leave it at night and nothing out here will."
hidden.rumour: Orrin says a quartermaster sells salves and torches at a camp inside the cleft south of his hut.

outpost._doc: Fort layout in the road frame: x across the road, z along it (the road's own direction is read from WorldGen at build time). The fort is centred on the Soldier career's post.
